profile.indexHint: Platform PostgreSQL · Cosine similarity · Float32. HNSW supports up to 2,000 dimensions. Model compatibility will be checked during indexing.
profile.parentChild: Search child passages and return parent context
profile.percentileValue: {value, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} percentile
profile.tokenEstimationHint: Sizes are estimates: UTF-8 bytes divided by {bytesPerToken, number}, rounded up. They do not use the model’s tokenizer. An independent byte limit from the verified model profile also bounds each passage.
profile.tokenWindowHint: Token windows follow canonical text order and may cross headings, paragraphs or pages. Their source spans retain the exact canonical offsets of the indexed extraction.
profile.tokenWindowTailHint: A short final passage is merged only when the maximum size and model byte limit allow it; otherwise it remains short. The minimum never causes a final passage to be discarded.
profile.semanticHint: The percentile uses the nearest rank of adjacent embedding distances. All positive ties at the threshold can create a boundary; it is not an exact percentage of splits. The size, overlap and verified model byte caps still apply.
profile.semanticWorkHint: Boundary planning adds document-role embedding calls using this saved model, dimensions, preparation, preset and credential binding. Accepted progress is persisted; a sealed plan keeps the same boundaries on retry. This may consume more provider usage than other chunking strategies.
profile.parentContextHint: Group consecutive child passages into larger context from the same indexed document. Search ranks children; the parent context is not embedded.
profile.parentSizeHint: The parent limit uses UTF-8 bytes divided by {bytesPerToken, number}, rounded up, with a separate cap of {maxBytes, number} bytes. It must cover the maximum child size. Parents do not use the embedding model’s context limit.

lifecycle.title: Versions and retention
lifecycle.description: Manage replacements, retained versions and private file cleanup.

lifecycle.replaceHint: Upload UTF-8 TXT/Markdown, a text-based PDF or a DOCX file, up to 25 MiB. The published original stays available until the replacement is ready. Collection links are preserved.
lifecycle.replaceFailed: The replacement could not be submitted. Reload to check the latest version, permissions, storage and available quota, then try again.
lifecycle.replaceRetentionHint: Choose 0–365 days, counted from this request, for newly retired versions. Files become eligible for removal after a newer version is published and this delay has passed. Active indexes and unexpired source references can retain them longer. Previously scheduled cleanup keeps its earlier eligibility date. Retained files continue to count toward storage usage.
lifecycle.deleteRetentionHint: Choose 0–365 days before remaining private files become eligible for removal. Zero schedules cleanup at the earliest opportunity, once active processing, index retention and unexpired source references allow it. Previously scheduled cleanup is never postponed. Storage usage is released only after cleanup succeeds.
lifecycle.deleteHint: Delete “{name}” from the library and every linked collection.
lifecycle.deleteWarning: Readers lose access immediately. This deletion cannot be undone from the dashboard, even during file retention. File removal runs in the background.
lifecycle.deleteFailed: Deletion failed. Reload to check the latest version and your permissions, then try again.
lifecycle.publishedHint: Preview and download show the published version. A failed replacement leaves that version available.
lifecycle.unpublishedHint: No version has been published yet. Follow processing or retry the latest failed attempt.
lifecycle.replacementPending: A version is being uploaded or extracted. Wait for it to finish before submitting another replacement.
lifecycle.deletedAt: Access was removed on {date}. File cleanup follows the retention deadline; retained metadata is for management only.
lifecycle.cleanupSchedule: Eligible for cleanup from {date}. Active processing, active indexes, unexpired source references or unavailable object storage can delay removal.

rebuild.title: Review index rebuild
rebuild.description: Compare serving revision {active, number} with saved revision {draft, number} before starting a new generation.
rebuild.availability: The current generation continues serving searches while the replacement builds. The replacement becomes active only after it catches up with document and metadata changes.
rebuild.sameProfile: The saved profile matches the serving profile. Rebuilding still creates a new generation and recalculates its passages and vectors.
rebuild.requirements: Keep the current model, credentials and vector destination available while they serve searches. The replacement uses temporary passage capacity. Another rebuild must wait until the previous candidate or retired table is physically cleaned up.
rebuild.cleanupAfter: Eligible for cleanup after {date}. Active source references may retain it longer.
rebuild.cleanupPending: Cleanup is pending. Another build is blocked until this generation’s vector table has been removed.
rebuild.discardDescription: Discard generation {id}. {active, select, yes {The serving generation remains available for searches.} other {This collection will still have no searchable generation.}} Documents in the library are retained.
rebuild.discardCleanup: Background cleanup removes the discarded vector table. Wait for cleanup to finish before starting another build.
rebuild.activeAvailable: Revision {revision, number} is serving searches · {model} · {dimensions, number} dimensions.

rebuild.savedProfileHint: Saving profile changes prepares the next rebuild. Searches continue using the serving profile shown in the indexing section.
rebuild.startNeedsDiscard: Retry the failed initial build or discard it. A new build becomes available after its vector table has been cleaned up.

indexing.reviewedCatalogHint: These choices come from a reviewed local model catalog. Listing them does not contact the provider or verify credentials. Verify the saved model before indexing.
indexing.reviewedProbeHint: Capabilities come from the reviewed local catalog. This verification made native document and query probes using the saved provider binding.

indexing.mistralPresetHint: Mistral uses the same native embedding protocol for documents and queries, with fixed-size vectors. The Generic preset adds no model-specific text prefixes.

indexing.observedResponseModelHint: The selected name above is requested from the provider. This observed response name is bound to the capability fingerprint and must remain stable for the saved profile.

semanticStages.SEMANTIC_PLANNING: Planning semantic boundaries. Accepted unit progress is saved between worker continuations.
semanticStages.WAITING_FOR_EMBEDDING_CAPACITY: Waiting for organization embedding capacity. The worker resumes automatically when capacity is available; waiting does not consume failure retries.
semanticStages.WAITING_FOR_EMBEDDING_WORK: Waiting for dispatched embedding work to settle or reach its deadline before cleanup can finish.

indexing.parentContextSourceHint: Context and matched passage come from the same exact indexed version. Source access is checked again when opened.
indexing.parentUnderfilled: The bounded child candidate window yielded fewer distinct parent contexts than requested. More eligible contexts may exist.

indexing.parentAccountingHint: Passage counters and quotas count searchable children. Parent context adds bounded stored text and is not embedded.
indexing.parentSealingStage: Verifying and sealing the complete child and parent layout before writing vectors.

synchronization.title: Automatic synchronization
synchronization.yourAccount: Your account is the configured synchronization controller.

hints.AUTHORIZED: New automatic indexing tasks use this controller’s current permissions. Existing tasks still require their own executor’s current access.
hints.ACCESS_REVOKED: The configured controller no longer has the required access. Adopt synchronization with an authorized account to resume future automatic work. Existing searchable publications remain available to authorized readers.
hints.UNADOPTED: This older generation has no saved controller. Initial and serving generations retain their historical document-change actor until adoption. Before first activation, retrying provisioning or document indexing can also configure the controller.

synchronization.counts: {pending, plural, one {# document awaiting publication} other {# documents awaiting publication}} · {blocked, plural, one {# failed task} other {# failed tasks}}
synchronization.noPendingDate: No current pending candidate date is available.
synchronization.metadataHint: These indicators describe this generation’s indexing state. They do not grant access to document content or guarantee that a worker is running.
synchronization.dialogDescription: Use your current permissions for future automatic updates and pending indexing work in this generation.
synchronization.pendingWork: Pending tasks will be assigned to your account. Running attempts will be interrupted and may repeat provider work, including billable requests.
synchronization.failedUnchanged: Failed tasks stay failed. Retry them individually from the document list or background tasks after reviewing their errors. Adoption alone does not restart a failed activation.
synchronization.rebuildRights: This pending rebuild requires both collection administration and document management access.
synchronization.profileUnchanged: The saved profile, read grants and document retention remain unchanged.
synchronization.stale: The controller or your permissions changed. Close this dialog and review the refreshed state before adopting.
synchronization.failed: Adoption could not be confirmed. The state has been refreshed; close this dialog and review it before trying again. A timed-out request may already have completed.
synchronization.success: Synchronization adopted: {pending, plural, one {# pending task reassigned} other {# pending tasks reassigned}}; {interrupted, plural, one {# running attempt interrupted} other {# running attempts interrupted}}. Failed tasks still need an individual retry.
synchronization.retryHint: Before first activation, retrying provisioning or document indexing also assigns synchronization to your account. Retrying work in a pending rebuild also transfers synchronization and requires collection administration and document management, except for cleanup tasks. In the serving generation, retries apply only to the selected task.

freshness.scope: This list follows the serving generation, or the initial generation before activation. A pending rebuild has its own progress above. Publication dates and candidate dates describe indexing, not the latest library upload.

states.BLOCKED: Publication update blocked by a failed task

freshness.retry: Retry the current failed indexing task for {name}

semantic.title: Semantic planning and embedding work
semantic.scope: These counters cover boundary and final-document embeddings for semantic indexing only. Other strategies and calls before tracking began are excluded. This is technical work accounting, not money, credits or a provider invoice.
semantic.notTracked: No semantic work has been tracked yet. Historical provider calls are not included.
semantic.unknownProviderTokenBatches: Batches with unknown native token usage
semantic.unknownBilledTokenBatches: Batches with unknown billed token usage
semantic.usageHint: Dispatches record intent and can include uncertain work. One logical batch may have up to three internal transport attempts; wire requests and charges are not counted exactly. Known token subtotals are incomplete when unknown batches remain. Missing usage never means zero.
semantic.embeddingBatchesPerCandidate: Lifetime logical batch allowance per candidate
semantic.limitsHint: 1 MiB = 1,048,576 bytes. Organization planning capacity must cover one document allowance; both outstanding work caps must admit a complete candidate allowance. A candidate shares its lifetime allowance across boundary planning, final embeddings and retries. Reducing limits does not remove stored data. Only a platform administrator can change limits.
semantic.sealed: The canonical plan is sealed. Retrying reuses its boundaries.
semantic.unsealed: Boundary planning is not sealed yet. Accepted progress is checkpointed.
semantic.taskHint: Planning adds document-role embedding work under the saved profile. Continuations do not consume failure retries. Usage may settle after a task loses its lease; stale results cannot advance its plan or publish content.

operations.title: Operations
operations.description: Find waiting or failed work and open its existing recovery workspace.
operations.scope: These totals cover outstanding durable work across the organization, including items you cannot inspect. Detail filters do not change the organization totals.
operations.unmeasured: Worker health, search activity, throughput and phase latency are not measured in this view.
operations.total: {count, plural, one {# outstanding task} other {# outstanding tasks}}
operations.noAcceptedWork: No outstanding work in this category.
operations.detailsHint: Only items allowed by your current document or collection access appear below. Open a workspace to inspect eligible recovery controls; this list does not grant recovery rights.
operations.search: Filter by document or collection name

states.EXPIRED: Processing claim without a valid lease

operations.timingHint: Age includes upload, queue wait, backoff and retries; it is not execution time. Due work still needs access, source and capacity checks. Scheduled cleanup may be waiting for retention. A processing claim does not prove a worker is active.
operations.visibleTotal: {count, plural, one {# matching item visible to you} other {# matching items visible to you}}
operations.empty: No visible work matches these filters. Organization totals may include work you cannot inspect.
operations.age: Age at this snapshot: {minutes, plural, =0 {less than a minute} one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
operations.attempts: {count, plural, one {# recorded attempt} other {# recorded attempts}}
operations.unknownFailure: A failure was recorded. Open the workspace to inspect the current safe diagnostic.

errors.CLEANUP_FAILED: Private file cleanup failed. Inspect its lifecycle workspace before retrying.

operations.paginationLimited: Paging covers the first {count, number} matching items. Narrow the filters to inspect further work.

telemetry.title: Recorded activity
telemetry.scope: Recorded extraction, indexing and search work for this organization, without query text, content or resource identifiers.
telemetry.loadFailed: Recorded activity could not be loaded. Check your current access and try again.
telemetry.denied: Your current permissions do not allow recorded activity.
telemetry.recordingHint: Buckets use database recording time in UTC, displayed in the dashboard timezone. The current hour is partial; starts and completions can fall into different buckets.
telemetry.bestEffort: Best-effort observations: restarts and recording failures can leave gaps. Recorded totals do not establish complete coverage.
telemetry.ledgerHint: These observations overlap semantic quota usage and must not be added to it. They are separate from enforced quotas and complete provider billing.
telemetry.retention: History before {date} is outside this view’s retention window.
telemetry.notTracked: Recording has not started for this organization.
telemetry.gapHint: Gap reports do not give a lost-request count or a precise loss interval. Zero reports does not prove complete capture.
telemetry.nativeTitle: Native embedding work and selected usage
telemetry.nativeHint: Logical native batches can contain transport retries. Vector counts include validated query, boundary and document vectors, not active searchable vectors. Model probes and discovery are excluded. Missing native usage stays unknown; known token totals are subtotals, not a complete bill.
telemetry.ioHint: Byte counts cover successfully observed logical source reads and artifact writes. Repeated completed I/O counts again; absent observations remain unknown.
telemetry.hourlyHint: Newest recording hours first, 24 per page. Missing observations are not measured zero activity.
telemetry.noDimensions: No recorded detail matches these filters.
telemetry.phaseHint: Observed samples only. Means use whole microseconds; p50/p95 are histogram bounds, not exact percentiles. Parallel phases overlap and must not be added.
telemetry.internalHint: Internal phase wall time excludes uncovered query-embedding wait, retains overlapping lexical work and excludes HTTP transport. It is separate from total search latency.
